meta.title: Testnet Reconnection & State Recovery
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Validate WebSocket reconnection and state recovery after disconnection to ensure the system is resilient to network failures.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: WebSocket reconnection with exponential backoff, succeeds within 30 seconds
Position state reconciled with exchange after reconnection
Order status synced after reconnection during active order
Exponential backoff follows correct formula: delay = min(base * 2^attempts, max_delay)

key-tasks.task: Create reconnection test infrastructure with disconnect simulation
Implement basic reconnection test (disconnect, reconnect, verify subscriptions)
Implement order sync test (disconnect during order, reconnect, verify status)
Test edge cases (rapid disconnects, disconnect during submission)

architecture-context.pattern: delay = min(base * 2^attempts, max_delay) Example: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, ... up to 60s max

technical-specifications.spec: async def force_disconnect(adapter): if hasattr(adapter, '_ws') and adapter._ws: await adapter._ws.close() await asyncio.sleep(1) # Wait for detection
